hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Maintain a neutral, reduced-risk posture. Cross-asset conditions are risk-on, but convictions are only marginally above neutral, alpha is negative for ETH/SOL/LTC, and 95% expected shortfall is material for BTC/ETH/SOL. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, while LTC is weak enough to remain flat. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile: their identical signals, zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and zero liquidity metrics strongly suggest missing or stale data rather than genuine low risk. Do not treat those metrics as evidence for increased conviction.
